items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I joined him on New Year's Eve... I did almost a year with him... So, then, I went with Pa Pa Bue and stayed almost a year with them

ctx.x: Yeah - but, there they just call them Pa Pa Bue. Jazz Band but it's actually the Viking Jazz Band and, uh, when they heard me play - the first few jobs that I had with a sizable band was with the Fessor's Big City Band and that was a swing band; I liked that very much -- they had some marvelous players. And, I was very surprised at the type of swing that they were playing. Wow -- it was really good. And, uh, so Pa Pa Bue heard me play with that band and he was losing a trumpet player -- now, I don't really--- I…

of the second year I was over there and I did almost a year with him and I really changed the style of the band. They were playing sort of a little swing and Dixie Land and sort of a George Lewis---kind of thing; they were sort of mixed up, about what they really wanted to play. So, I got them going on---
